gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto X part 3 records. NFKC colon, French-parenthesis, hyphen, and kana aliases are resolved to the paired names. Pathos and Logos in prose abbreviate their full status labels. Preservation is the status while passive 152701 is Conservation. Skill-number requirements, E.G.O permission only for Third Movement, Meursault defeat conditions, blueprint-driven HP loss, fixed Coin probabilities, unknown Offense Levels, and uncertain single-Coin effect numbering are retained.

name.text: Jeanne (Canto X, Route C Final Battle)

stageName.text: Sisyphus Department Store C: Bright Room, Final Battle

lead.text: In Phase 1, kill blueprints before “Focusing” can consume them. In Phase 2, match Meursault's skill numbers to advance the waltz. In Phase 3, kill blueprints to reduce the body's HP instead of attacking it directly. Protect Meursault's HP and assignments; do not assume he can repeatedly survive lethal damage as in the preceding Chaplain battle.

listLead.text: In Phase 1, kill blueprints before “Focusing”. In Phase 2, match Meursault’s skill numbers to advance the waltz. In Phase 3, kill blueprints to lower body HP. Protect Meursault: the previous battle’s survival effect does not carry over.

statNote.text: Route C's final battle. The Phase 1 body is Lv. 90 with 2,793 HP and base Defense Level 94. Phase 2 is immune to damage; the Phase 3 body has no directly targetable part. Blueprints have 178 HP in Phase 1 and 730 HP at Lv. 65 in Phase 3. Phase 1 blueprint Stagger Thresholds are unconfirmed. Aim for Customer Lv. 65, separately from Identity levels outside the dungeon.

skillNote.text: Skill levels are marked unknown where no level is listed or the actual Offense Level of a blueprint-granted skill is unconfirmed. Phase 2 Evade “We had our little quarrels, yes.” has unconfirmed displayed Power. The Le Rouge blueprint's “Pattern: "Don."” retains its listed one Coin, with the Bleed Count effect's Coin number marked unconfirmed.

priorities.0.text: Protect Meursault; do not assign skill-number or named-recipient clashes to another Sinner.

priorities.1.text: Phase 2 requires Skill 1 → Skill 2 → Skill 3 or E.G.O. Check the actual equipped enemy skill's requirement.

priorities.2.text: In Phase 3, win transformed blueprint clashes with Meursault, apply Fragile, then kill the blueprint.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Clashes became much harder after blueprints appeared

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: If Jeanne kills a blueprint with “Focusing”, she gains Nailed; at 3, it becomes Engagement. Her Heads chance becomes 100%, while your Coins are fixed unfavorably. Do not try to clash with “Focusing”; kill its blueprint target first.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: HP does not decrease at all in Phase 2

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: This phase is immune to damage and does not require HP reduction. Match Meursault's skill number to the enemy's requirement and advance Pathos to 100. Do not try to bypass it with area attacks or statuses.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Even Meursault's E.G.O has unfavorable Coins

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Phase 2 “First Step” requires Skill 1 and “Second Pace” requires Skill 2. Only “Third Movement” permits E.G.O. Increasing Power alone cannot counter the wrong-number punishment skill.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: I cannot attack Jeanne herself in Phase 3

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: This phase does not involve direct attacks on the body. Target Le Noir and Le Rouge blueprints; their deaths lower body HP. Clash with transformed Sartorial Tailor blueprints using Meursault to inflict Fragile, then plan their elimination.

troubleshooting.4.symptom.text: Blueprints heal and the battle does not progress

troubleshooting.4.advice.text: Check that Meursault clashes with the transformed blueprint's “At least on this stage, everything's set and fixed.” Another Sinner or an unopposed attack changes it to a punishment skill that heals 50% max HP. Le Rouge's defense also heals, so concentrate damage on one blueprint you can finish.

troubleshooting.5.symptom.text: A key Sinner's Coins become unfavorable next turn

troubleshooting.5.advice.text: Désespoir fixes positive Coins to 100% Tails and negative Coins to 100% Heads. Rights: Ban applies it After Attack, so a clash win alone does not prevent it. Do not keep that Sinner on an important clash next turn; use defense, healing, or another recipient.

phases.0.title.text: Protect Meursault and prepare damage for blueprints

phases.0.steps.0.text: Check shopping toward Customer Lv. 65 on Route C. Identity levels follow Customer Level in the dungeon. E.G.O Threadspin is not boosted, so check available effects and resource costs too.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Prepare HP recovery and Protection for Meursault, plus E.G.O damage for blueprints. Meursault's death causes defeat in Phases 1 and 2; do not carry over The Stranger's 1 HP protection from the Warden battle.

phases.0.steps.2.text: The final battle has no preceding action encounter where you reduce the body's HP. Each phase needs different actions; check skill conditions instead of relying only on auto-selection.

phases.1.title.text: Kill blueprints before “Focusing” and prevent Nailed

phases.1.steps.0.text: Every three turns, three blueprints are summoned and the body gains a Shield equal to max HP, removes Stagger, and cannot be Staggered that turn. Clear blueprints before pouring everyone's damage into the Shield.

phases.1.steps.1.text: “Focusing” prioritizes blueprints, is Unclashable, and cannot be redirected. Check targeting lines and use fast Sinners to kill blueprints before Jeanne gains Nailed.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Blueprints take 50% less basic attack damage and 100% more E.G.O damage. However, they use defense before the first hit to greatly reduce that skill's damage. Do not assume one skill will kill them; check remaining HP.

phases.1.steps.3.text: Sinner kills on blueprints grant 5 total E.G.O resources of scarce affinities. Use them for the next cleanup and healing while advancing to 50% body HP. Win against Unbreakable skills such as “Fixed Viewpoint” for 80% reduction.

phases.2.timing.text: When Nailed or Engagement is present

phases.2.title.text: Do not confuse fixed Coin chances with low SP

phases.2.steps.0.text: Nailed fixes Heads chance at 95% and gives the clash opponent −2 Clash Power at 2 Stack. At 3, it changes to Engagement next turn. Killing blueprints before she consumes them prevents this buildup.

phases.2.steps.1.text: During Engagement, Jeanne has 100% Heads. Units clashing with or attacking her have positive Coins fixed to 100% Tails, negative Coins to 100% Heads. SP recovery or high Power alone cannot remove these fixed chances.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Removed when “Focusing” is equipped or on Stagger. Check whether the effect has ended rather than repeatedly forcing difficult clashes on the same key Sinner.

phases.3.title.text: Choose Meursault's skill number to match the enemy skill

phases.3.steps.0.text: Jeanne takes no damage in this phase. Advance Pathos to 100 rather than reducing HP to 0. Check the skill generated in Meursault's upper slot and the enemy's requirement.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Use Skill 1 against “First Step”, Skill 2 against “Second Pace”, and Skill 3 or E.G.O against “Third Movement”. Numbers refer to Identity skill numbers, not Coin count.

phases.3.steps.2.text: A wrong number changes the attack to “You've got to keep to the pattern.”, fixing Coins unfavorably. Do not substitute E.G.O for requirements 1 or 2. Keep taking the required clashes rather than simply defending and waiting.

phases.3.steps.3.text: In this phase, Meursault clears negative effects and gains fixed SP and Stagger prevention, but not damage immunity. Positive-Coin Identities have 45 SP; negative-Coin Identities have −30. Do not confuse his effects with Jeanne's damage immunity.

phases.3.steps.4.text: Clash results and exchanges, dialogue skills, and Evade increase Pathos and Logos. At 100 Pathos, Phase 3 begins. Logos is a separate effect increasing Meursault's Offense Level and Clash Power.

phases.4.title.text: Use Meursault against transformed blueprints to create Fragile

phases.4.steps.0.text: The body cannot be targeted directly and starts at 50% HP. Le Noir and Le Rouge blueprints are replenished to two of each. Each blueprint death reduces body HP by 5%.

phases.4.steps.1.text: From the second turn of Phase 3, one blueprint becomes the Sartorial Tailor. Stagger is removed on transformation; do not assume Stagger makes it safe to ignore.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Always clash with “At least on this stage, everything's set and fixed.” using Meursault and win. Another Sinner or an unopposed attack changes it to the punishment skill and prompts major healing.

phases.4.steps.3.text: After Meursault wins, that blueprint gains 5 Fragile every turn from next turn onward. Prioritize killing it. Other Sinners handle blueprint normal clashes and damage.

phases.5.timing.text: Blueprint deaths and added Rights skills

phases.5.title.text: Rotate recipients with unfavorable Coins and focus blueprint damage

phases.5.steps.0.text: Each time the Sartorial Tailor form ends, another blueprint starts using Jeanne's Rights: Ban. It applies Désespoir for next turn After Attack regardless of the clash result. Avoid fixing affected Sinners to important clashes.

phases.5.steps.1.text: A blueprint death gives other blueprints Délaissement; next turn, one blueprint equips Rights: Gaze. Win against Gaze for 80% reduction and to prevent next-turn Désespoir.

phases.5.steps.2.text: Délaissement increases both Clash Power and damage taken. At 4 or more, Turn Start removes all Stagger Thresholds, clears Stagger, and increases slot weight by 1. Exploit increased damage taken to finish them rather than waiting for Stagger alone.

phases.5.steps.3.text: Le Noir uses Shields; Le Rouge uses self-damage and healing. Do not chip everyone down: focus on a Fragile or low-HP blueprint while preserving Meursault's required clash.

phases.5.steps.4.text: The phase ends at 10% body HP or less. Progress through blueprint kills instead of direct body attacks. Do not assume you can receive “Rights: Rebuild”'s death-on-hit effect through immortality as in the Chaplain fight.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Maximum 3. Heads chance 95%; at 2 Stack, the clash opponent has −2 Clash Power. At 3, consume all to gain Engagement next turn. Loses 1 at Turn End except on the turn gained.

mechanics.0.response.text: Kill Phase 1 blueprints before “Focusing” to prevent buildup.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Own Heads chance 100%. Units clashing with or attacking this unit have positive Coins fixed to 100% Tails and negative Coins to 100% Heads. Removed on equipping “Focusing” or becoming Staggered.

mechanics.1.response.text: High SP cannot override fixed unfavorable chances. Clear blueprints and check effect removal.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Special Charge. Jeanne gains 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed; Count does not naturally decrease. At Turn End, gain Poise Potency based on Count and Poise Count based on Potency.

mechanics.2.response.text: Also strengthens Evade and area skills. Do not assume prolonging the fight favors you.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Fixes Phase 2 Jeanne's SP to 45 and makes her immune to damage. Removed at phase transition.

mechanics.3.response.text: Increase Pathos through the required waltz skills rather than damage.

mechanics.4.effect.text: On gaining it in Phase 2, Meursault removes negative effects and gains fixed 45 SP (−30 for negative-Coin Identities) and Stagger prevention. Removed at phase transition. Does not grant damage immunity.

mechanics.4.response.text: Follow skill-number requirements while protecting HP. Stagger immunity is not death immunity.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Phase 2 progression, maximum 100. Increases by 3 on Jeanne's clash win, by 5 on her loss, and additionally by clash exchanges. Certain skills also increase it. At 100, advance to the next phase.

mechanics.5.response.text: Track this value instead of body HP. Follow skill numbers and continue the waltz.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Meursault's accumulating effect, maximum 100. Gains 5 on a clash win and increases by clash exchanges. Offense Level +1 per 10 Stack, Clash Power +1 per 20. Certain skills also increase it.

mechanics.6.response.text: Separate from Pathos. Also keep Meursault's required Phase 3 clashes in mind.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Fixes positive Coins to 100% Tails and negative Coins to 100% Heads. Loses 1 at Turn End. Rights: Ban applies it for next turn After Attack; Rights: Gaze applies it when the enemy wins the clash.

mechanics.7.response.text: Their application conditions differ. Use another recipient or defense rather than forcing the affected Sinner into next turn's high-Power clash.

mechanics.8.effect.text: Maximum 5. Clash Power +1 and skill damage taken +10% per Stack. At 4 or more, remove all Stagger Thresholds, clear Stagger, and gain +1 slot weight at Turn Start.

mechanics.8.response.text: Both offense and damage taken increase. Combine with Fragile to finish them instead of waiting for Stagger.

mechanics.9.effect.text: The Le Noir blueprint's special Charge. Gains 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed. Enables stronger Shields and damage from skills.

mechanics.9.response.text: Do not leave its defensive Shield indefinitely; focus a blueprint that is easier to kill.

mechanics.10.effect.text: The Le Rouge blueprint's special Charge. Gains 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed. Self-damage from its own skills cannot lower HP below 1.

mechanics.10.response.text: Attack after self-damage. Do not wait for self-destruction; kill it before healing.

mechanics.11.effect.text: A skill added to blueprints. Its first Coin is Unbreakable; applies Désespoir for next turn After Attack.

mechanics.11.response.text: Winning does not prevent application. Reconsider next turn's recipient.

mechanics.12.effect.text: 3 Atk Weight and two Unbreakable Coins. Strengthened by special Charge and negative effects. On a clash loss, deals 80% less damage and cannot Stagger targets with its damage.

mechanics.12.response.text: Win with a high-Power recipient and prevent next-turn Désespoir too.

warnings.0.text: Meursault's death causes defeat in Phases 1 and 2. Do not carry over 1 HP protection from the Warden / Chaplain battle.

warnings.2.text: The Phase 2 body is immune to damage. Meursault's Stagger prevention does not grant that immunity.

warnings.3.text: The Phase 3 body cannot be attacked directly. Use Meursault to clash with transformed blueprints' required skills.

warnings.4.text: Désespoir fixes Coin chances. Neither 45 SP nor high-Power E.G.O alone removes it.

warnings.5.text: “Rights: Rebuild” kills On Hit. Progress through blueprint kills rather than assuming Meursault can take lethal hits.

preparation.2.text: Phase 1 blueprints are vulnerable to E.G.O and grant resources on death. Save area-attack and healing resources for Phase 3 required clashes and finishing damage.

roles.0.reason.text: Handles the waltz's skill-number requirements and transformed blueprint clashes in Phase 3. Protect his HP first.

roles.1.reason.text: Prevents Phase 1 “Focusing”; in Phase 3, kills Fragile blueprints to lower body HP.

roles.2.reason.text: Recovers from Unbreakable hits and fixed unfavorable chances to keep Meursault alive.

roles.3.reason.text: Win Gaze to reduce damage and avoid forcing clashes on Sinners with Désespoir.

passives.0.effect.text:
Every three turns, summon 3 Grand Magasin Sisyphe Blueprints and gain a Shield equal to own max HP.
- Remove Stagger if present and cannot become Staggered that turn.

Killing blueprints with “Focusing” grants Nailed.

At 3 Nailed, change it to Engagement.
If no blueprint is killed by own “Focusing”, gain 1 Fragile next turn.

passives.0.response.text: Kill blueprints first to prevent Nailed. Avoid concentrating excessive direct damage into the body's summon Shield.

passives.1.effect.text:
At Stage Start, begin at 45 SP.

Meursault's death causes the Sinners to lose.

At 50% HP or less, stop taking damage and change phases.
- On transition, remove dispellable negative effects.

passives.1.condition.text: Meursault death and body at 50% HP or less

passives.1.response.text: Meursault's death causes defeat. Do not assume The Stranger's survival effect from the preceding Chaplain battle applies.

passives.2.effect.text:
Gain 1 Inertia of Drifting Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed during battle.
- Inertia of Drifting Count does not decrease at Turn End.

At Turn End, gain Poise Potency equal to Inertia of Drifting Count (max 10).
At Turn End, gain Poise Count equal to Inertia of Drifting Potency (max 5).

Damage taken from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking −60%.
- Stagger Threshold rise from Tremor −60%.

Gain +1 Clash Power per 10 clash exchanges against the same target.

passives.2.condition.text: Inertia of Drifting consumption and long clashes

passives.2.response.text: Status damage and Tremor threshold rise are reduced by 60%. Status-only damage or prolonged clashes do not guarantee victory.

passives.3.name.text: Remember the rhythm of the waltz?

passives.3.effect.text:
If a clash lasts at least 4 exchanges, per 4 exchanges, the unit that won the third exchange gains +15% damage (up to 3 times).
- If that skill also won the first exchange, Final Power +1.

passives.3.condition.text: Clashes lasting at least four exchanges

passives.3.response.text: Clash progression changes damage. Displayed Power alone cannot determine the result.

passives.4.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.4.response.text: Lowering SP does not keep Panic active indefinitely.

passives.5.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.5.condition.text: Gaining an effect that changes Panic type

passives.5.response.text: Do not rely on normal Panic-type changes to stop actions.

passives.6.effect.text:
Before the first hit in battle, use the equipped “Department Store Blueprint” regardless of targeting, once per turn.

Basic skill damage taken −50%.
E.G.O skill damage taken +100%.

Dies when hit by Jeanne Sartre, the Sartorial Tailor's “Focusing”.

passives.6.condition.text: Phase 1 blueprint, before the first hit

passives.6.response.text: Basic attacks are reduced; E.G.O works well. Kill before “Focusing” to prevent Nailed.

passives.7.effect.text:
When killed by a Sinner's skill, grant 5 total E.G.O resources one at a time to the affinity with the lowest reserves.
If multiple affinities tie for lowest, select randomly.

passives.7.condition.text: Blueprint killed by a Sinner's skill

passives.7.response.text: Gain 5 total resources of scarce affinities. Turn blueprint cleanup into the next area attack and healing.

passives.8.name.text: Remember the experience of the waltz?

passives.8.effect.text:
Take no damage during this phase.

At Turn Start, gain 1 Être-pour-soi and 1 Pathos - Désir d'être; grant Meursault 1 Être-pour-autrui and 1 Logos - Manque d'être (once per battle).

On receiving an unopposed attack or losing a clash, activate “We had our little quarrels, yes.”
Generate specific skills in Meursault's upper slot.

passives.8.condition.text: Phase 2 start, unopposed attacks, and clash losses

passives.8.response.text: The body takes no damage in this phase. Follow Meursault's skill numbers and track Pathos.

passives.9.effect.text:
Meursault's death causes the Sinners to lose.

At 100 Pathos - Désir d'être, change phases when the current skill ends.
- On transition, remove dispellable negative effects.

passives.9.response.text: Advance at 100 Pathos, not through HP damage. Keep Meursault alive and continue the required waltz.

passives.10.effect.text: If Jeanne's HP reaches 10% or less...

passives.10.condition.text: Phase 3 body at 10% HP or less

passives.10.response.text: Blueprint deaths lower body HP. Do not assume the subsequent sequence is an ordinary attack endurance battle.

passives.11.effect.text:
SP fixed at 45.

At Turn Start, summon Sisyphe System Blueprint - Le Rouge and Le Noir until two of each exist.

From the second turn after transition, transform one blueprint into Jeanne Sartre, the Sartorial Tailor.
- Prioritize a blueprint without Fragile.
- Exclude the blueprint transformed last turn.
- Clear Stagger if present.

In Sartorial Tailor form, use “At least on this stage, everything's set and fixed.”
- If Meursault wins its clash, that blueprint gains 5 Fragile every turn from next turn.

Each time the Sartorial Tailor form ends, one blueprint equips Jeanne's Rights: Ban from next turn.
- The number equipping Jeanne's skill increases cumulatively by one.

On blueprint death:
- Jeanne loses 5% HP.
- Other blueprints gain 1 Délaissement.
- Next turn, one blueprint equips Rights: Gaze instead of Rights: Ban.

passives.11.response.text: Clash with transformed blueprints using Meursault and win for Fragile, then kill them to damage the body.

passives.12.effect.text:
Gain +1 Clash Power per 10 clash exchanges against the same target.

From one turn after appearing, one blueprint changes into Jeanne Sartre, the Sartorial Tailor.
- Prioritize a blueprint without Fragile.
- Exclude the blueprint transformed last turn.
- Clear Stagger if present.

In Sartorial Tailor form, use “At least on this stage, everything's set and fixed.”
- If Meursault wins its clash, that blueprint gains 5 Fragile every turn from next turn.

On blueprint death:
- Jeanne loses 5% HP.
- Other blueprints gain 1 Délaissement.

passives.12.response.text: Exploit Fragile from Meursault's clash win to finish it. Check Délaissement on other blueprints too.

passives.13.effect.text: Gain 1 Preservation Potency per cumulative 10 Preservation Count consumed during battle.

passives.13.response.text: Higher Preservation Potency strengthens defensive Shields and other effects. Focus a blueprint you can finish rather than leaving it indefinitely.

passives.14.effect.text:
Gain +1 Clash Power per 10 clash exchanges against the same target.

From one turn after appearing, one blueprint changes into Jeanne Sartre, the Sartorial Tailor.
- Prioritize a blueprint without Fragile.
- Exclude the blueprint transformed last turn.
- Clear Stagger if present.

In Sartorial Tailor form, use “At least on this stage, everything's set and fixed.”
- If Meursault wins its clash, that blueprint gains 5 Fragile every turn from next turn.

On blueprint death:
- Jeanne loses 5% HP.
- Other blueprints gain 1 Délaissement.

passives.14.response.text: Shares the same transformation and death effects. Assign Meursault to required skills as with Le Noir.

passives.15.effect.text:
Gain 1 Pulsation Potency per cumulative 10 Pulsation Count consumed during battle.

HP loss from own skills cannot lower HP below 1.

passives.15.condition.text: Cumulative Pulsation Count consumption and self-damage

passives.15.response.text: Self-damage alone cannot reduce HP below 1. Kill it with Sinner attacks instead of waiting for self-destruction.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「ジャンヌ（10章C最終戦）」: Jeanne (Canto X, Route C Final Battle) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. In Phase 1, kill blueprints before “Focusing” can consume them. In Phase 2, match Meursault's skill numbers to advance the waltz. In Phase 3, kill blueprints to reduce the body's HP instead of attacking it directly. Protect Meursault's HP and assignments; do not assume he can repeatedly survive lethal damage as in the preceding Chaplain battle.
